notes: 2026-09-12: DR-0034 is LANDED, closed by IDX-SNAP-V0-018 (decision 0095), which adopts the Go index path screen including .claude; query and eval drop the disclosure. No admission label changes.
2026-09-08: DR-0032 is OPEN and disclosed for ocm. The missing-case hint does not promote the command or change any admission label; its adjudication and corpus gap remain pending.

2026-09-04: DR-0014 closed, so the register holds no open entry and openDivergences is empty. That removes the only divergence-shaped blocker on this record; every remaining blocker below is missing measurement, not an unrepaired defect.

No command is admitted to beta at this revision. GPK-V0-042 accepts no evidence class weaker than the three it names, and one of the three has never returned a sufficient verdict: every report under conformance/perf-v0/results/ carries outcome insufficient_evidence, including the retained seven-command report (S, conformance/perf-v0/results/seven-command-2026-09-04/report.json, pinned at revision b7f9f489 rather than current HEAD, 100 measured samples per runtime across all eleven scopes), because GPK-V0-017 criterion (d) requires that no OTHER supported command regress and, per S, record and migrate-traces now measure FAIL on p95 and/or peak-resident while ocm-prepare-resume and both lrf scopes remain NOT_RUN (unequal-stderr).

Decision 0007 D1 term 4 states that all three evidence sources are 'already green'. At this head that premise does not hold for any of the three: the 2026-08-28 merged-head GPK-V0-017 run (conformance/perf-v0/results/corvint-2026-08-28-merged-head/report.json) reports 11 PASS / 0 FAIL / 3 NOT_RUN with outcome insufficient_evidence, and the retained seven-command report S (pinned b7f9f489, 2026-09-04) reports 9 PASS / 7 FAIL / 8 NOT_RUN, also insufficient_evidence; the W11 report is PASS on reproducibility while carrying pendingEvidence W10-performance-GPK-V0-016-017 and smoke NOT_RUN on four of five targets; and W12's GPK-V0-021 self-dogfood closes NOT_PROVEN overall while GPK-V0-022 carries NOT_APPLICABLE and PARTIAL rows and GPK-V0-024's fourth sentence is NOT_PROVEN. The rung is real and the machinery is in place; the evidence is not yet there to use it.

query has exactly one PASS (w11ReproducibleBuild), the same as every other command; its own gpkV0017Criteria and w12DogfoodAndRollback are both NOT_RUN, so no command is a near miss on the count of sources. query's blockers are the slice-wide criterion (d) gap and the absent GPK-V0-043/GPK-V0-044 repository-profile evidence: no accepted performance, Corvint/Beamfall dogfood, or rollback run exists for that profile, so the compatibility label remains FALLBACK. S (pinned b7f9f489, outcome insufficient_evidence) adds partial criterion (d) evidence for cem, ocm, lrf, record, and migrate-traces, but none reaches query's own authority-start depth: cem's two PASS scopes share an empty-stdout/exit-2 result, ocm-prepare-resume and both lrf scopes are NOT_RUN (unequal-stderr), and record and migrate-traces now carry FAIL scopes on at least one corpus.

Every admission is additionally bounded by execution evidence existing on darwin/arm64 alone. GPK-V0-018 states cross-compilation is not execution evidence, so admitting a command on a platform whose native matrix has not run would claim more than W11 proves.
